result.topic_en: The page holds a cyclic system of five equations, a factorization identity used to express the logarithm of 10037 through other logarithms with a decimal correction, and successive derivatives of a function satisfying dx/dφ = √(1−x⁴), the lemniscatic sine.

methods.what: Cyclic system of five equations in the unknowns p, q, r, s, t, each of the form a·(product of two unknowns) + b·(unknown) + c = product of three unknowns
Numerical identity: 10037·97·691 + 1 factors into easy numbers
Logarithm of 10037 expressed through logarithms of other numbers, using the factorization identity (approximate, before correction)
Correction term for the logarithm computation, written as a sum of fractions
Long periodic decimal expansions; the first row is the period of 2/9 + 9/13 = 107/117, the second the period of 2/23
Successive derivatives of a function x(φ) with dx/dφ = √(1−x⁴) (lemniscatic sine)
Second-order differential equation for s, partly smudged
